_about: The fixed set of messages scripts/run_profile.py sends to a profile (PR-005 section 10, Q06-27, Q08-5, T-06.2). `points` is what a good answer must contain, one tickable line each in the saved report: a person ticks them (the script checks only that every message got an answer). `profiles` limits a message to the profiles it makes sense for (no key: every profile). `points_for` replaces `points` for one profile where it answers something else (`identification` answers a classification, `gesture` an emotion). `then` is the user's answer to the question a message makes the profile ask: it is sent as the next message of the same run (the paused-run path) and has its own `points`; if the profile did not ask, the report says so. Sandbox codes only (CL-1001), never a real customer.
